title: Software Testing
standfirst: Unit, integration and system testing — plus the theory of what testing can and cannot guarantee.

description_paragraphs: This course prepares students to understand requirement-based testing phases, formulate precise test requirements, design and execute test cases within a standard development environment, and apply specialized test design techniques for specific application domains.
faculty: Prof. Meenakshi D'Souza, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIIT Bangalore

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Software testing - Software development life-cycle, terminologies; Test automation.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Graphs and algorithms; Structural graph coverage criteria; Algorithms for coverage-based testing.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Graph and data flow testing; Coverage criteria; Unit testing.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Integration and specification testing; Graph coverage; Finite state machines; Code coverage.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Logic basics; Coverage criteria; Clause and predicate coverage; Logic-based testing.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Logic coverage examples; Coverage specification; FSM coverage; SMT solvers..

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Symbolic testing; Concolic execution; Symbolic execution examples.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Requirements; Functional testing; Input space partitioning; ISP examples.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Regular expressions and CFGs; Mutation testing; Mutation operators; Testing criteria comparison; Integration and tools.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: OO integration concepts; Mutation operators; OO testing and faults; Coupling criteria.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Web applications; Client-side testing; Server-side testing.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Regression testing; Quality metrics; Non-functional testing; TDD; Summary.
